Summarise capacity by zone, height, size, location or binding constraint

Source: R/summarise.R
summarise_capacity.Rd

One function for every breakdown of a capacity result. by names what to group by; measures names what to report. Every site is counted once, in one group, so groups always add up to the total.

Usage

summarise_capacity(
  cap,
  by = "zone",
  measures = default_measures(),
  areas = NULL,
  area_id = NULL,
  grid = NULL,
  breaks = list(),
  include_zero = TRUE
)

default_measures()

Arguments

cap

A capacity result from estimate_capacity().

by

Character vector of groupings (see the section); NULL for one total row.

measures

Character vector of measures.

areas

Polygons for by = "area".

area_id

Column of areas naming each area.

grid

Cell size (m) for by = "grid".

breaks

Named list overriding the band breaks: height (m), site_size (m2) and far.

include_zero

Whether sites with no capacity (open space, unzoned) are counted. They are by default, so land area reconciles.

Value

A data frame of class plancap_summary, one row per group; an sf data frame of the areas or cells for a spatial grouping.

Grouping (by)

Any column of cap$sites (such as zone_key, zone_code, method, path, variant, flag, envelope_binding, dwelling_binding), and:

  • "zone": the zone key;

  • "storeys": the number of storeys the envelope reaches;

  • "height_band": the envelope's height, in bands (breaks$height);

  • "site_size_band": site area, in bands (breaks$site_size);

  • "far_band": the floor area ratio achieved, in bands (breaks$far);

  • "binding": the constraint that limits dwellings (dwelling_binding);

  • "area": the polygons given as areas, labelled by area_id; each site is assigned to the area that covers most of it ("(outside)" where none does);

  • "grid": square cells of grid metres, by each site's point on surface;

  • "storey": floor area by storey level (where capacity sits vertically), from the storey stack: a site counts in every storey it reaches, and only floor area measures apply.

Measures

sites, land_area, footprint, floor_area, residential_floor_area, business_floor_area, dwellings, minor_dwellings, floor_area_mean and floor_area_median (per site), dwellings_mean, far (floor area over land area), floor_area_per_ha and dwellings_per_ha (of land), floor_area_share and dwellings_share (of the total), and the *_with_bonus columns. "gfa" is accepted for floor_area.

See also

capacity_table() to format it; summary.plancap_capacity()

Examples

town <- exampleton()
sc <- scenario("Operative", rulebook_example("exampleton"),
               parcels = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "land", ],
               roads = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "road", ],
               zoning = town$zoning, layers = town[c("height_areas", "transit")])
cap <- estimate_capacity(sc)
summarise_capacity(cap)
#> <plancap summary> Operative, by zone_key: 6 rows
#>  zone_key sites land_area floor_area dwellings  far floor_area_share
#>       HDR   272   215,500    529,519     5,594 2.46            25.2%
#>       IND    24    48,000    115,200         0 2.40             5.5%
#>       LDR   108    96,000     64,920       103 0.68             3.1%
#>       MDR   714   512,500    748,147     7,754 1.46            35.7%
#>        MU   176   128,000    384,000     2,132 3.00            18.3%
#>        TC    85    64,000    256,000     1,342 4.00            12.2%
summarise_capacity(cap, by = c("zone", "height_band"), measures = c("sites", "floor_area"))
#> <plancap summary> Operative, by zone_key, height_band: 9 rows
#>  zone_key height_band sites floor_area
#>       HDR       0-9 m     2        434
#>       HDR     12-16 m    25     17,944
#>       HDR     16-22 m    96    153,944
#>       HDR     22-30 m   149    357,196
#>       IND     12-16 m    24    115,200
#>       LDR       0-9 m   108     64,920
#>       MDR      9-12 m   714    748,147
#>        MU     12-16 m   176    384,000
#>        TC     22-30 m    85    256,000
summarise_capacity(cap, by = "storey")
#> <plancap summary> Operative, by storey: 6 rows
#>  storey sites floor_area floor_area_share
#>       1 1,379    643,225            30.7%
#>       2 1,378    641,683            30.6%
#>       3 1,269    602,569            28.7%
#>       4   355    149,980             7.1%
#>       5   245     43,497             2.1%
#>       6   149     16,832             0.8%
